args.title: Fix false 'Malformed row' error from trailing blank line in parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, only a single trailing newline is stripped, so a file ending with a blank line (two trailing newlines) leaves one empty-string line that gets parsed as a data row and fails assertShape. Update the trailing-line handling (or the loop) to skip/ignore truly blank trailing lines instead of treating them as malformed rows.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseStatement only strips a single trailing newline, so a file ending with a blank line (trailing \n\n) leaves one empty-string line that gets parsed as a data row, causing assertShape to throw a false 'Malformed row' error. The fix should skip/ignore truly blank trailing lines instead of treating them as malformed data.
